about: Clips whose art EmberEngine replaces (Engine2's file stays untouched in C:/Engine2). Applied to the battle pack's manifest and the heroes file by tools/scripts/sprites/apply_sprite_overrides.py. Paths are relative to the repo root.

speed.why: the user, 2026-10-17: Malrec's casting and ATT are far too slow (his clips run 3.33 s at 10.8 fps, then the fight plays them at its pace: more than 5 s a cast)

the user, 2026-10-17: Voss cut from their Veo videos (Attachments/VeoVoss) as a new sprite set, his default; voss-final kept (its back pose stays on Poison Breath); every native frame, the video's own resolution
